m: अर्म m. pl. ruins, rubbish, VS. xxx, 11; TS. &c., often ifc. in names of old villages half or entirely gone to ruin (e.g. गुप्तार्म, कुक्कुटार्म, बृहद्-अर्म, &c., qq.vv.), Pāṇ. vi, 2, 90 seq. and viii, 2, 2, Sch.
a: अर्मः --र्मं — [ऋ-मन् Uṇ. 1. 137] 1 A disease of the eye. --2 A country to which one should go (गंतव्यदेशः or चिरंतनग्रामनिवासः). --3 A cemetery.

m: अर्मण m. n. a measure of one droṇa, Suśr.
a: अर्मणं — A measure of one droṇa.

m: अर्मक अम्, rubbish, ruins, RV. i, 133, 3.
अर्म-कपाल m. n. a potsherd from a heap of rubbish, TS.
अर्मन् n. a disease of the eyes, Suśr.
a: अर्मन् — n. [ऋ-मनिन्] A disease of the eye (said to be of 5 kinds).

s: klI, puM, (f + man .) cakzUrogaviSezaH । iti liNgAdisaMgrahe amaraH ॥ tacca paYcaviDaM । prastAryyarmma 1 SuklArmma 2 raktArmma 3 mAMsArmma 4 snAzvarmma 5 । ezAM lakzaRAni tattatSabde drazwavyAni । vEdyake nAntaklIvaliNgo'yaM SabdaH ॥

v: na॰ f + manin । netrarogaBede “prastAriSuklakzatajADi mAMsasnAyvarmasaMjYAH Kalu paYca rogAH । syuHSuktikA cArjjuna pizwakO ca jAlaM sirARAM piqakAScaMyAH syuH । rogA balA sagraTitena sArdDamekAdaSAkzRoH Kalu SuklaBAge । prastAri graTitamihArmBa SuklaBAge vistIrRaM tanuruDirapraBaM sanIlam । SuklAKyaM mfdu kaTayanti SuklaBAge saSvetaM samamiha vardDate cireRa । yanmAMsaM pracayamupEti SuklaBAge padmABaM tadupadiSanti lohitArmma । vistIrRaM mfdu vahalaM yakftprakASaM SyAvaM vA tadaGikamAMsajArmma vidyAt । Sukle yat piSitamupEti vfdDimeti, iti suSru॰ । arma yajjAlavadvyApi tadapyunmArjyalambitam । armma cAlpandaDiniBannIlaM raktamaTApi vA । Cedyameva tadarmmasyAt kfzRamaRqalagaYca yat” । armmavanmaRqalAgreRa vaqiSenAvalambinA । armmARi piqakAM hanyAtsirAjAlAni tena vE” iti ca suSru॰ ।
